title: Brand booklet
essence: A scrapbook with a menacing streak: the work torn out, taped up and introduced like a JoJo villain, in an old-money study after dark.

identity.wordmark: ILYAS in Bowlby One on an amber block, Ishenaliev in DM Serif Display italic on paper: a ransom note cut from two papers, each piece a few degrees off straight.
is: A showcase of projects, experience and content.
A way to grow the audience a little.
Proof of taste: the things Ilyas loves say as much as the work.
isNot: A hire-me page: no services, pricing or “let's work together”. Not open to collabs or client work.
A contact sheet: no phone number or email anywhere public.

voice.summary: Sarcastic, cynical and self-aware. Sure about the work, unbothered about everything else.
principles: Undercut the brag: say the win, then puncture it.
Short sentences. One joke per line at most.
Specific beats clever: name the thing (V4–6, Little Shop of Horrors, After Hours).
Ilyas writes the final words. Anything Claude drafts is a placeholder.
do: Margin notes that argue with the main text (“← accurate, sadly”).
Buttons that sound like a person: “See the work”, “All nine →”.
Labels written like a museum with less dignity.
dont: Corporate filler: passionate, leverage, synergy, journey.
Asking for collabs, clients or DMs.

samples.line: Creative · Marketer · Professionally falls off walls
I edit videos, design posters, and start hobbies faster than I finish them. This site is mostly proof I finished one.
Shows, sports, books and hobbies, labelled like a museum would if it had less dignity.
Torn by hand, more or less.

voice.sfx: Sound effects are English comic lettering: ZZZIP!, FLIP!, THE WORLD!, ACT 4!. The only Japanese on the site is the menacing ゴゴゴ, drawn in purple with a dark outline.

typeNote: Type grows with the window: the base size runs from 16px on phones to 24px on big monitors. Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px, labels and stamps included.

motifs.name: Torn paper
motifs.how: Every sheet, photo and label has ripped edges. Each tear is seeded, so it's unique but never changes between visits.

motifs.name: Ransom-note name
motifs.how: The name is cut from two papers and two fonts, each piece tilted a few degrees.

motifs.name: Tape
motifs.how: Translucent strips pin photos and posters down, always crooked. A strip belongs to what it holds and moves with it.

motifs.name: Hard shadows
motifs.how: Paper casts a solid offset shadow in the shape of its tear. No blur.

motifs.name: Moving stripes
motifs.how: Thick vertical stripes pan sideways forever: RL navy, accent 1, RL red, accent 2, RL green.

motifs.name: Walnut & brass
motifs.how: Dark panelled wood with brass trim on the nav and as a floor under the footer, like a Ralph Lauren Home study.

motifs.name: Die-cut stickers
motifs.how: Stickers with a white cut edge float in the margins, four down each side. Eight slots (bear, cheese, rocket, crest, tea, sheep, patch, toast), each holding a drawn original or an uploaded picture.

motifs.name: Menacing ゴゴゴ
motifs.how: Purple ゴ letters stepping down a diagonal and trembling. Each letter is the uploaded ゴ picture (Keystatic → Stickers), or the font if none is uploaded. Drama only, used sparingly.

motifs.name: Marker notes
motifs.how: Highlighter swipes, hand-circled words and margin notes that talk back.

motifs.name: Stamps
motifs.how: Platform tags and tilted labels in mono capitals.

motifs.name: Now spinning
motifs.how: A torn label taped under the headshot on Home shows what's playing on Spotify right now (with three little equaliser bars), or the last thing played. It links to the song and hides when Spotify isn't connected.

imagery: Real photos only: events, posters, video thumbnails, the headshot. No stock.
Video work is shown moving: a short silent loop of the real clip, with its still as the first frame.
Photos are clippings: torn edges, a slight tilt, taped down.
The headshot is cut out like a sticker and sits in front of the collage.
Project pages can carry a process gallery: storyboards and screenshots taped up as evidence.

The drawn stickers are originals. Any of them can be swapped for an uploaded PNG with a transparent background. Uploads are scaled to cover about the same area as the others, so a tall guitar comes out narrower, not bigger.
Artwork, characters and products owned by others are covered by a general disclaimer at the foot of every page (Keystatic → Site details → Footer disclaimer).

principles: Every page change is a full-screen JoJo Stand transition: cover the screen, swap the page underneath, reveal.
Bursts start from where the visitor clicked.
A click, Esc, Space or Enter skips the animation.
Keyboard navigation and reduced-motion settings get a quick fade instead.
Only move and fade things. Nothing grows from zero.

easing.name: Pop
easing.use: Cards and labels that land with a bounce

transitions.feel: Purple ゴゴゴ trembles in, then a torn card lands: “Welcome to Ilyas’ portfolio”.
Golden rectangles and a spiral draw in, nails fly, and the scene spins away around the eye.
Blue panels slide in, a gold zip closes the screen, then unzips onto the page.
The screen becomes a book and the pages swing over to the project.
Time stops from the click: a grey freeze, a gold wall and a clock.
Torn strips in the palette colours stack across the screen with the page name.
A sepia freeze and the To Be Continued arrow before leaving the site.

ambient: Background stripes pan across every 30 seconds.
On Home the hero collage drifts slightly with the mouse, each layer at its own depth. Mouse only; it settles back when the cursor leaves.
The Now spinning label checks Spotify every 30 seconds while the page is open, and swaps the song without a reload.
Smooth scrolling, paused while a transition is on screen.
After a transition: headings come in word by word, highlighter and circles draw themselves on, and paper pastes in as it scrolls into view.
Real clips from the work play as silent loops in place of their stills: only while on screen, only after the transition, never with reduced motion.

layout: Fully fluid: everything scales from phone to ultra-wide.
The side margin grows from 16px to 96px; content stops widening at 110rem.
Sections alternate: open collage on the stripes, then a full-width sheet of torn paper.
On phones some stickers hide so the margins stay clear.
